Their A-grade markets remain extremely active one day after run7's check, with recent sales-history turnover continuing in the minutes-old range across all 6 cards; active-listing price levels are broadly similar to run7 with normal day-to-day noise. The BGS9.5 listing on Card 8 (ジラーチex SAR) at ~¥4,900 remains active and unchanged; the Card 11 (ピカチュウex SAR, night) PSA9 slot noted absent since run7 remains absent. Notable findings among the 5 established cards vs run7 (collected the same day, ~15:01 JST): (1) Card 1 (ピカチュウVMAX CSR) PSA10 lowest listing dropped further to ¥28,000 from run7's ¥29,500, continuing its steady multi-run downward drift; sales history is unchanged (no new sale in the ~8 hours since). This is a genuine listings-vs-sales divergence: sellers are currently asking well above what buyers have actually been paying, worth watching in the next run to see whether sales catch up to the new asking level or listings retreat back down. Card 4's A-grade side is unchanged (still only 1 listing, ¥335,500, no new sale since 2026/06/29). (5) Card 5 (名探偵ピカチュウ プロモ) PSA10 held steady at ¥42,000 (matching the base-page tile exactly, no discrepancy); A-grade also steady at ¥27,000 lowest, with 2 new sales (¥26,500 and ¥28,000, both ~1 day old) confirming the ¥26,500-28,000 level continues to hold firm with no reversion toward the earlier ¥32,000-38,500 range. pokeca-chart.com index figures are byte-for-byte identical to run7's, as expected per the skill's documented behavior since both runs occurred on the same JST calendar day (data_range still 2026/09/16) - PSA10 index at 115,636 yen (day -1.8%, month -23.2%, year +21.4%), raw/美品 index at 52,303 yen (day -0.1%, month -3.8%, year +29.8%).
